_planted: PR #50 is admitted and mergeable, but its baseRefName is a stacked parent branch that was never retargeted to the default branch because the parent's head branch was left undeleted after its own merge -- squash-merging #50 would land content into the parent, not main, while GitHub still reports state=MERGED with a real mergedAt timestamp, indistinguishable from a real landing (issue #335).
